pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū vutthavassā āraññakesu senāsanesu viharanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.1.6: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave āraññakesu senāsanesu viharantena tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitunti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhagavatā anuññātaṃ āraññakesu senāsanesu viharantena tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitunti. te tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitvā atirekachārattaṃ vippavasanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.2: tāni cīvarāni nassantipi vinassantipi dayhantipi undurehipi khajjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.6: athakho te bhikkhū bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitvā atirekachārattaṃ vippavasissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.9: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.10: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitvā atirekachārattaṃ vippavasantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.13: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitvā atirekachārattaṃ vippavasissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.14: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.16.1: upavassaṃ kho pana kattikapuṇṇamaṃ. yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni senāsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni tathārūpesu bhikkhu senāsanesu viharanto ākaṅkhamāno tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipeyya. siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.17: chārattaparamantena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabbaṃ. tato ce uttariṃ vippavaseyya aññatra bhikkhusammatiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.5: yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni senāsanānīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.9: ārāme ārāmupacāre corānaṃ niviṭṭhokāso dissati bhuttokāso dissati ṭhitokāso dissati nisinnokāso dissati nipannokāso dissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.11: ārāme ārāmupacāre corehi manussā hatā dissanti viluttā dissanti ākoṭitā dissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.17: saṅghāṭiṃ vā uttarāsaṅgaṃ vā antaravāsakaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.20: siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāyāti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.28: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.31: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ atirekachārattaṃ vippavutthaṃ aññatra bhikkhusammatiyā nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.36.1: atirekachāratte atirekasaññī vippavasati aññatra bhikkhusammatiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.37: atirekachāratte vematiko vippavasati aññatra bhikkhusammatiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.38: atirekachāratte ūnakasaññī vippavasati aññatra bhikkhusammatiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.44: avilutte viluttasaññī vippavasati aññatra bhikkhusammatiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.45: nissaggiyaṃ cīvaraṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.52: chārattaṃ vippavasitvā puna gāmasīmaṃ okkamitvā vasitvā pakkamati
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.53: antochārattaṃ paccuddharati vissajjeti nassati vinassati dayhati acchinditvā gaṇhāti vissāsaṃ gaṇhāti
